security_findings.finding: Client-controlled role: POST body.role and GET roleOverride are passed into reviewService and used instead of the server-resolved role
security_findings.impact: A CLIENT_VIEWER/COLLABORATOR can approve by sending role:'CLIENT_OWNER'

security_findings.finding: Review mutations do not verify versionId belongs to reviewId; comment/annotation accept arbitrary versionId
Approval does not require review.approvalAllowed/status check server-side (only capability), so approving a REVISION_IN_PROGRESS or SUPERSEDED review is possible if currentVersionId matches
security_findings.evidence: reviewService.ts:345-358 (no review.approvalAllowed check; decline does check perms at 497-498)

security_findings.finding: RLS is service_role-only on review tables; no per-client policies; enforcement is API-only

Admin feedback endpoint gates on isAdminEmail but assertReviewProjectAccess also requires owner match, so admins not owning the project get FORBIDDEN — the founder cannot actually read client feedback

tests_note: Tests exercise preview-client-room fixtures (memory store under Vitest) and pure shared builders. No test covers: production review object creation, send-to-client, workspace consumption of client decisions, auth header presence on client hooks, role-tampering rejection, inbox/library real data.
role_tamper_scope_note: Project access is checked before the client-supplied role is used (reviewService.ts:241); the defect lets a viewer/collaborator act as CLIENT_OWNER inside a project they can already access, not reach other projects.
